rapport_notes: Warm, patient tone; active listening with confirmation; professional handling of patio items, plants, and special equipment concerns.
process_discipline_notes: Agenda question asked after extensive logistics probing rather than before (violates sequencing); no silence held after the estimate pitch to allow consideration.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: None present; rep launches directly into address confirmation and logistics.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Jeline: 'Alright, so let me know discuss the pricing structure and the estimate but before that do you have any concern about the moving process?' — Asked AFTER all logistics have been probed (bedrooms, garage, driveway, boxes, appliances, furniture, etc.).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answered 'No ma'am' to the agenda question with no follow-up, so no second layer possible. Earlier probing (crib assembly, propane tank, plant types) was logistical, not concern-discovery.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Jeline: 'First is we do have the no worry damage coverage so this actually provides you up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages.' — Covered in Stage 2 takeaway (pricing perks).
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Never mentioned. No reference to crew lead, Meet Your Mover, or who will actually show up.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Jeline: 'Also we do have the on time guarantee if we cannot make it at the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of the final bill.' — Covered in Stage 2.
evidence_quotes.communication: Not covered anywhere. No mention of day-before call, crew lead assignment, or inbox updates.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor_and_personalize: Jeline: 'normally for a 1500 square feet house, we finish the move-in six to eight hours but in your case we're coming from a one story house but there are special items that we have to take extra care off which is like the fridge Washer/Dryer and the large team he's going to Aitor he has and the drive time could be between thirty minutes to an hour. So for this move sir, I estimate list to finish in eight hours to nine hours with three movers and one truck. So the estimated amount for this is $2,304 to $2,592' — Gives range and personalizes to single-story source, special items (appliances, TVs), and drive time.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_window: Jeline: 'of course Lawrence, this is only my estimate, if ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we used during the move.' — Window concept covered.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Jeline: 'the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments' and 'if ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we used during the move.' — Beats estimate logic covered.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Jeline: 'So let's say for example, in the move date you are really ready, like our movers will just focus on moving all the furniture into our truck, then that would really help keep the time down. So obviously the last. Last time we take the less money end up spending at the end of the day.' — Self-prep tip covered.
evidence_quotes.does_that_feel_fair_silence: Line not asked. After estimate, Jeline pivots to 'Would you like to be on the schedule for Thursday? September? I mean, Tuesday September 29th' without soliciting acknowledgment or agreement.
evidence_quotes.close_rate_lock: Never mentioned. No reference to rate locking upon booking.
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Jeline: 'Would you like to be on the schedule for Thursday? September? I mean, Tuesday September 29th no deposit is required.' — Attempt to close, but customer declines ('No, not at this time. I'm gonna do some more shopping around'). Rep pivots to email follow-up with no recovery close.

top_strength: Exceptional logistical detail-gathering—thoughtful handling of special items (propane tank, plants, TVs, patio furniture), proactive liability waiver mention for plants, and personalized estimate anchor (acknowledging single-story source, special items, drive time).
coaching_note: Ask the agenda question (their biggest concerns) before any logistics probing starts, and hold silence after the estimate to let the customer process—both are critical to discovery and close momentum; also introduce Communication differentiator (day-before call, crew lead, updates) as part of the Stage 2 takeaway.
